comparison.objective: Restore pulse-oximetry monitoring by refitting a slipped finger probe; no spec versions are available.
comparison.physical_skill: Fit a probe over a fingertip with 3 mm side clearance.
comparison.success_condition: Probe refitted and reading restored; silencing the alarm alone scores zero.
comparison.reason: Probe placement and monitoring restoration test neither contact-driven notch fracture nor impact-tool use and fragment recovery.
